translate_en|mods/CompanionDogsLabrador/: A hunting dog built to bring it back: it trains Hunting twice as fast, with Obedience close behind. By design it is one of the worst fighters in the family: only the Pug bites weaker, no knockdown, and a brawl leaves it badly rattled. Its gift is its mouth. It brings its kills back to you from the moment it can hunt, instead of waiting for a high Hunting skill, never drops one on the way, and often turns up carrying something else it found (Soft Mouth). Common in homes, and hangs around hunting cabins, campsites, boathouses and ranger stations. Butchering what it brings you also comes easier with it around.
Your Labrador brings back every kill from its first hunt on, and often something extra. While it is nearby, fed and loyal, you also learn Butchering and Short Blade faster.
